scripts.build: npm run build -w @ai-box/contracts && npm run build -w @ai-box/backend && npm run build -w @ai-box/frontend
scripts.check: npm run build -w @ai-box/contracts && npm run check --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @ai-box/contracts && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.format: prettier --write frontend/src frontend/tests backend/src backend/tests shared/src desktop/src scripts/*.mjs docs .github *.md
scripts.desktop: npm run build:desktop && npm run start -w @ai-box/desktop
scripts.dist:desktop: npm run build:desktop && npm run dist -w @ai-box/desktop
